entry.title: Link and correlation between BOI's and API's, differences in functionality and testing tools
entry.content:
Hi all,

We are developing in a S/4 Public Cloud environment (using embedded steampunk or ABAP cloud).

As part of the developments ahead, we need to "rebuild" classic developments, which use commonly known BAPIs such as BAPI_GOODSMVT_CREATE, which are not allowed in Public cloud, based on clean core principles.

As we move forward in research of the new ways, we found out (based on the Material Document example):

- There's a Material Document Business Object: Material Document

- There's a Material Document Business Object Interface (BOI), which is intended to be used for LOCAL (embedded) RAP developments as the ones we need: MaterialDocument / I_MATERIALDOCUMENTTP

- There's a Material Document API, which is intended to be used for SIDE-BY-SIDE (from BTP) or consumed from OUTSIDE S/4 (not the majority of our current scenarios): API_MATERIAL_DOCUMENT_SRV

We also found out, while both are present and documented on Business Accelerator Hub, the API one is far more documented and friendly for a functional analyst, including even a Try-Out section to test it with data. Which is very useful as it is needed to elaborate functional specs including test cases.

This poses a problem since what we will end up using from ABAP code (by EML) is the BOI, not the API. Some people already posted in regards to this, having problems because they are not in sync in functionality or capabilities: https://community.sap.com/t5/technology-q-a/functional-differences-between-boi-s-and-api-s/qaq-p/13879790 https://community.sap.com/t5/technology-q-a/how-to-call-public-cloud-sap-api-from-embedded-steampunk/qaq-p/13725569

In analogy to the classic approach, the analyst was able to test the BAPIs from SE37 with data, and even save test cases to be used by reference for the developer.

Since we have no similar tool for BOIs, how we can assure and correlate the API and the BOI? Is there a 1:1 equivalence listing? Are there any plans for a BOI testing tool similar to the one provided for APIs?

Thank you!

I have  created an editable alv report on PO.

check this code is fine or not. please let me know.

TABLES: ekpo.

wa_ekpo TYPE ekpo.

wa_fcat TYPE slis_fieldcat_alv,
wa_layo TYPE slis_layout_alv.

* START-OF-SELECTION
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
START-OF-SELECTION.

PERFORM get_data.
PERFORM build_fieldcat.
PERFORM display_alv.

*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
* Get data
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_data.

SELECT *
FROM ekpo
INTO TABLE it_ekpo
UP TO 100 ROWS
where ekpo~ebeln IN s_ebeln.


ENDFORM.

*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
* Build field catalog
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM build_fieldcat.

CLEAR it_fcat.

" EBELN - not editable (key)
CLEAR wa_fcat.
wa_fcat-col_pos = 1.
wa_fcat-fieldname = 'EBELN'.
wa_fcat-seltext_l = 'PO Number'.

" EBELP - not editable (key)

wa_fcat-col_pos = 2.
wa_fcat-fieldname = 'EBELP'.
wa_fcat-seltext_l = 'Item'.
APPEND wa_fcat TO it_fcat.

" AEDAT - display only
CLEAR wa_fcat.
wa_fcat-col_pos = 3.
wa_fcat-fieldname = 'AEDAT'.
wa_fcat-seltext_l = 'Change Date'.
APPEND wa_fcat TO it_fcat.

" TXZ01 - editable
CLEAR wa_fcat.
wa_fcat-col_pos = 4.
wa_fcat-fieldname = 'TXZ01'.
wa_fcat-seltext_l = 'Short Text'.
wa_fcat-outputlen = 40.
wa_fcat-edit = 'X'.
APPEND wa_fcat TO it_fcat.

" MATNR - display only (you can make it editable if needed)
CLEAR wa_fcat.
wa_fcat-col_pos = 5.
wa_fcat-fieldname = 'MATNR'.
wa_fcat-seltext_l = 'Material'.
APPEND wa_fcat TO it_fcat.

" MENGE - editable
CLEAR wa_fcat.
wa_fcat-col_pos = 6.
wa_fcat-fieldname = 'MENGE'.
wa_fcat-seltext_l = 'Quantity'.
wa_fcat-edit = 'X'.
APPEND wa_fcat TO it_fcat.

" NETWR - editable
CLEAR wa_fcat.
wa_fcat-col_pos = 7.
wa_fcat-fieldname = 'NETWR'.
wa_fcat-seltext_l = 'Net Value'.
wa_fcat-edit = 'X'.
APPEND wa_fcat TO it_fcat.

CLEAR wa_layo.
wa_layo-colwidth_optimize = 'X'.

ENDFORM.

*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
* Display ALV
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_alv.

CALL FUNCTION 'REUSE_ALV_GRID_DISPLAY'
EXPORTING
i_callback_program = sy-repid
i_callback_user_command = 'USER_COMMAND'
is_layout = wa_layo
it_fieldcat = it_fcat
TABLES
t_outtab = it_ekpo
EXCEPTIONS
program_error = 1
OTHERS = 2.

IF sy-subrc <> 0.
MESSAGE 'Error in ALV display' TYPE 'E'.
ENDIF.

ENDFORM.

*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
* USER COMMAND
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM user_command USING r_ucomm TYPE sy-ucomm
r_selfield TYPE slis_selfield.

CASE r_ucomm.

WHEN '&DATA_SAVE'. " Triggered by Save (Ctrl+S) in ALV

PERFORM save_data.

" Refresh ALV after save
r_selfield-refresh = 'X'.

ENDCASE.

ENDFORM.

*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
* Save data: update ALL rows from internal table to EKPO
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM save_data.

" Update all entries based on primary key (EBELN+EBELP)
MODIFY ekpo FROM TABLE it_ekpo.

IF sy-subrc = 0.
COMMIT WORK.
MESSAGE 'All changed rows saved successfully' TYPE 'S'.
ELSE.
ROLLBACK WORK.
MESSAGE 'Error while updating EKPO' TYPE 'E'.
ENDIF.

ENDFORM.

entry.title: Need Suggestions for FB60 Mass Upload (Non-PO) – BDC vs BAPI
entry.content:
Need Suggestions for FB60 Mass Upload (Non-PO) – BDC vs BAPI

 

Hi Developers,

 

I have a requirement to develop an FB60 mass Non-PO invoice uploader, where invoices are grouped based on the Reference Number.

 

I have already developed a BDC solution, and the posting process is working correctly. However, I'm facing an issue while capturing messages from the BDC execution.

 

The problem is that even when the transaction encounters an error or warning, the returned message type is sometimes 'S' (Success). Currently, I am filtering based on Message Type and Message ID to identify successfully posted documents, but this approach is not reliable in all scenarios.

 

The business users also want to see detailed error information for records that failed during upload. However, many SAP standard error messages are not user-friendly, making it difficult for end users to understand what went wrong and which field caused the issue also it has a more than 1 line error .

 

A few additional points:

 

- This is a relatively old SAP ECC 6.0 system.

- Before suggesting a BAPI solution, please note that I have already explored BAPI options.

- In my system, automatic tax code calculation is not available.

- The BAPI approach worked only for invoices without tax codes.

- I would also like to avoid manually generating the second line item that FB60 normally creates during manual entry or BDC processing.

 

My questions are:

 

1. How do you reliably identify successful and failed postings in FB60 BDC processing?

2. Is there a better way to capture and present meaningful error messages to users?

3. Has anyone successfully implemented this using a BAPI in an older ECC system, including tax handling?

4. If you have sample code or a working approach (BDC or BAPI), it would be greatly appreciated.

 

Thanks in advance for your suggestions.

entry.title: S/4 HANA Public Cloud 2608 - ABAP XLSX parser issue
entry.content:
Hello SAP Community,

after the 2608 upgrade I started to face an issue. We have a RAP application with a custom action for uploading an Excel file. The Excel file is then parsed into an internal table and processed further. The issue is, since 2608 upgrade the action is ending in a shortdump BEHAVIOR_ILLEGAL_STATEMENT.

I investigated and found following difference in the standard SAP code (class CL_XCO_XLSX_RA_VT_STRING_VALUE -> local classes

->method if_xco_xlsx_ra_cell_reader~write_cell_to_field) :

2602

2608

The issue is, in our Excel file we have a column with amount - which should be parsed into abap decimal (13,2) field. The code correctly identifies the field as Packed (P), however for some reason "P" is not between the allowed types and throws the exception. This will cause the shortdump mentioned earlier. Any idea how to parse the file successfully with a decimal field? I tested it on 2602 and there it works like a charm.. 

The parsing code in our RAP action is:

 
DATA(lo_document) = xco_cp_xlsx=>document->for_file_content( lv_file_content )->read_access( ).

DATA(lo_worksheet) = lo_document->get_workbook( )->worksheet->at_position( 1 ).

DATA(o_sel_pattern) = xco_cp_xlsx_selection=>pattern_builder->simple_from_to(
      )->from_column( xco_cp_xlsx=>coordinate->for_alphabetic_value( 'A' )
      )->to_column( xco_cp_xlsx=>coordinate->for_alphabetic_value( 'AA' )  
      )->from_row( xco_cp_xlsx=>coordinate->for_numeric_value( 2 )  
      )->get_pattern( ).
    lo_worksheet->select( o_sel_pattern
                                     )->row_stream(
                                     )->operation->write_to( REF #( lt_sheet_data )
                                     )->set_value_transformation(                                         xco_cp_xlsx_read_access=>value_transformation->best_effort
                                     )->execute( ).​

 I tried also tried xco_cp_xlsx_read_access=>value_transformation->best_effort and xco_cp_xlsx_read_access=>value_transformation->identity .

One thing that occured to me is to implement own value transformation... which is a quite setback as this was supposed to be an upgrade 😄

Thanks in advance,

Matus

entry.title: How to Resolve Old ArchiveLink Document References After Content Repository Migration?
entry.content:
We migrated our Archive Link content repository from A1 to ZA some time ago. Recently, we found that certain employee attachments in PA30 fail to open with:

"Error in HTTP Access: IF_HTTP_CLIENT->RECEIVE – Direct connect to host failed."

Attachments that already point to ZA open without any problem — the failure only happens on some historical documents.

Debugging showed that these failing documents still had TOAHR entries pointing to the old A1 repository. When SAP resolves the document via CREP, it tries connecting to the old A1 content server, which is no longer valid/reachable — hence the failure.

As a test, we tried manually changing the repository value in TOAHR from A1 to ZA. That produced a different error instead:

"Document does not exist in repository ZA."

So a straight repository-ID swap doesn't work.

entry.title: Building an ATC-Based Transport Release Assistant with AI Code Suggestions in SAP GUI (ECC)?
entry.content:
Hi SAP ABAP Community,

I'm currently developing a custom ABAP tool and would appreciate feedback from experienced SAP developers on whether this solution is useful, whether similar functionality already exists in SAP ECC, and whether my proposed UI architecture is technically feasible.

Background

I've heard that in SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Public Edition, certain development and transport processes can enforce ATC checks before changes are released or deployed.

This made me wonder:

Is there any standard functionality in SAP ECC / SAP GUI that prevents a transport request from being released until specific ATC or Code Inspector findings are resolved?

If such functionality already exists, I'd like to understand it before continuing with a custom solution.

What I've developed so far

I'm currently testing this on an SAP_BASIS 740 system using SAP GUI.

My prototype can:

Read an ABAP program and check whether it has opted in for review.

Execute Code Inspector checks programmatically using ABAP classes.

Extract findings, including severity, check description, source line, and surrounding source-code context.

Store the execution results in custom database tables (ZOKG_LOG_HDR and ZOKG_LOG_ITEM).

Identify a program with findings and automatically open it in the standard SE38 ABAP Editor in Change mode.

Display a separate AI Code Review screen using CL_GUI_CUSTOM_CONTAINER and CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT, with a Copy Code button.

Currently, the AI code is sample output. Integration with an LLM to generate actual corrections is planned.

The longer-term goal is to integrate this with the CTS transport-release process using IF_EX_CTS_REQUEST_CHECK~CHECK_BEFORE_RELEASE, so that relevant findings can be reviewed before releasing a transport request.

Current limitation: Two SAP GUI sessions

At present, my tool opens two separate SAP GUI sessions:

Session 1: The actual SE38 ABAP Editor, with the target program opened in Change mode.

Session 2: My custom AI review screen displaying suggested code.

This works, but I would prefer to provide the entire review experience within the SE38 window.

What I want to achieve

When my tool opens a program in SE38, I would like a dialog box to open automatically within that same SAP GUI session.

The dialog would contain a tabstrip with two tabs:

Tab 1 — AI Suggested Code

Display the AI-generated corrected ABAP code in a read-only editor, with an option to copy the suggested code. The developer can review the suggestion and manually apply the changes in SE38.

Tab 2 — ATC / Code Inspector Findings

Display the findings for the current program, including severity, description, line number, and relevant source-code context.

I would also like to add a button to the SE38 toolbar, such as AI / ATC Review.

The expected behavior would be:

The review dialog opens automatically when the program is opened through my tool.

The developer can close the dialog and continue working in SE38.

The SE38 editor remains open.

The developer can click the AI / ATC Review button at any time to reopen the dialog.

My technical questions

Existing functionality: Does SAP ECC already provide a standard ATC or Code Inspector-based transport-release gate? Are there established alternatives such as CTS checks or transport quality gates?

SE38 enhancement: Is there any supported BAdI, customer exit, enhancement point, or API that allows a custom dialog and toolbar button to be integrated into the standard SE38 ABAP Editor?

GUI session handling: Since RS_TOOL_ACCESS with IN_NEW_WINDOW = 'X' opens the editor in another SAP GUI session, is there a supported way to initialize and reopen a custom dialog from within that editor session?

Architecture: Would you recommend extending the standard SE38 interface, developing a custom editor/review transaction, or keeping the current two-session approach?

Project value: Do you think a tool combining pre-release ATC checks, source-code context, AI suggestions, and developer-controlled corrections would be useful in an ECC development environment?

I'm trying to keep the implementation maintainable and avoid modifications to SAP standard objects.

I'd appreciate any suggestions, relevant SAP documentation, existing tools, or alternative approaches.

Thanks in advance!
